en: Black-and-white winter scene showing a row of wooden buildings in deep snow. The houses have steep gabled roofs covered with snow, and signs on the façades identify a hotel and an apothecary (pharmacy). The setting appears to be a small Nordic town or village, with a wide snow-covered street or open area in the foreground and forested hills in the distance. Printed caption text is visible at the top of the image.
